#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    int prev = -1;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        int segmentLength = i - prev - 1;
        
        if (c == '_') {
            if (!inside) {
                maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, segmentLength);
            } else if (segmentLength > 0) {
                insideWords++;
            }
        } else if (c == '(') {
            inside = true;
            maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, segmentLength);
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inside = false;
            if (segmentLength > 0) {
                insideWords++;
            }
        }
        
        if (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')') {
            prev = i;
        }
    }
    
    maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, (int)s.length() - prev - 1);
    std::cout << maxOutside << " " << insideWords << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
